content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Fire safety and building MEP contracting for buildings, not road, highway or paving construction."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Designs and sells asphalt plants and crushers as an equipment manufacturer, not a builder or producer of asphalt and aggregates."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Recurring commercial landscape maintenance and irrigation services for property owners, unrelated to road construction."},{"label":"C4","good":true,"reason":"Self-performs site work, paving and crushed stone with its own asphalt plant, selling to developers and municipalities, closely matching the target."},{"label":"C5","good":true,"reason":"Builds highways and bridges for public agencies while producing aggregates, asphalt and concrete from owned quarries and plants, like the target."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Electrical, lighting and data systems contracting, a different trade from road and heavy civil construction."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Rail track components, friction management and inspection for railroads, not roads or highway paving."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Mechanical, electrical and plumbing contracting for building systems, not roads or heavy civil work."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Telecom, power and pipeline network construction for infrastructure owners, not road or highway building."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Precast concrete barriers and culverts plus design licensing; a product manufacturer without paving or aggregate production."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Cement manufacturer and ready-mix producer selling materials, with no road building or paving services."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Railcar manufacturing and leasing; highway guardrail is a minor line, not road construction."}]}
